zh: 详情面板可以切换大小。底部面板改为直角，收紧把手和间距，侧栏图标跟随面板开合。
侧栏开合改为连续动画，重复送达的相同状态不再让整块看板重绘。平板上切换大小时，先移动底部面板，再更新看板。
搜索更早的任务时分段加载，可以暂停或继续；停止按钮的按下反馈与其他按钮一致。
悬停位置时显示目录。父任务状态增加悬停说明，「推断」改为「历史关联」，并注明这是按归档时间推测的，可能不准。
en: Resize the details panel. The bottom panel uses square corners and tighter spacing, and the sidebar icon follows whether the panel is open.
Animate the sidebar as it opens and closes, and skip redrawing the board when the same status arrives again. On a tablet, changing the size moves the bottom panel before the board updates.
Load older tasks in stages while searching, with pause and resume, and match the search stop button’s press feedback.
Show the directory when hovering a location. Parent status has a hover hint, and a former parent is labeled as history inferred from archive timing and may be wrong.
